options.name: base_table
options.description: Specification of the SWIS table to base the query upon and the columns to be included.

options.name: filters
options.description: Filters for inclusion and/or exclusion of records based on values. If multiple filter elements are provided, they function as alternatives (that is to say, they are combined using SQL C(OR)).

options.name: nested_entities
options.description: Specification of entities that are accessible from the base table, for example C(Agent), C(Interfaces), C(Volumes), etc. Each key should be the relative name of the nested entity, so for example, for the base table C(Orion.Nodes), the nested entity C(Orion.Nodes.Interfaces) is accessible via C(Interfaces). For each nested entity, individual columns can be specified below via the I(columns) option, otherwise all columns will be returned.
